limitations: Previously reviewed diagnostic subset; this is not a new relevance holdout or full357-query quality study.
Single-shot means freshly loaded encoder subprocesses; OS caches were not flushed.
Sequential policies and phases on a battery-powered16GiB Mac with10.5–11.2GiB swap in use; background load was not isolated. These are observed timings, not an isolated AC-power benchmark.

Resident cold is one startup observation per precision. Multiple sessions multiply retained models. RSS is sampled, can double count shared pages, and does not measure total allocation or swapped/compressed pages. No8GiB certification.
Native inference only on macOS. Windows/Linux type checks are not native platform validation.
